messages.subject: VECM Partial Beta Restrictions
parts:
Dear all,

I am currently doing my Masters Thesis on fiscal dynamics and need to estimate several VECMs.
I started exploring R and the tsdyn package and now I have a doubt concercing restrictions on the cointegration vector.

When one wants to estimate a VECM with a restricted Beta, but only partially, for example, let us assume that the VECM has one Cointegration Equation and three variables and the restriction at hand would be to force the first variable in the ECT to be equal to one. How do I specify this restriction on the beta argument present in the VECM command?

Thank you in advance,

Jaime

messages.author: 8c45483022d450d5
messages.subject: Re: [tsDyn] VECM Partial Beta Restrictions
parts:
Dear Jaime

It is unfortunately not possible to do partial restrictions with the VECM() function in tsDyn. Have a look at the functions in urca/vars, which allow some more flexible restricted estimation.

Best

Matthieu
